title: Bandit Submodular Maximization under Matroid Constraints: Learning Compressed Exchange Policy
abstract: arXiv:2608.24627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study adversarial bandit maximization of monotone submodular functions under a matroid constraint. For a rank-$k$ matroid on $n$ elements, we give a randomized oracle-polynomial algorithm that makes one feasible value query per round and has expected $(1-1/e)$-regret $\widetilde O(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})$. This is the first sublinear-regret algorithm for adversarial bandit submodular maximization under general matroid constraints.   Technically, we view the problem as learning an exchange policy for the Poisson base walk. This connects the problem to contextual bandits and gives an information-theoretic sublinear-regret guarantee, but directly learning the exponentially many policies requires exponential time and space. We therefore introduce \emph{balanced fractional exchanges}, which compress the policy mixture into a single fractional base while retaining the exchange information needed by the Poisson analysis. translated_title: 拟阵约束下的强盗子模最大化：学习压缩交换策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24627v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究了在拟阵约束下单调子模函数的对抗性强盗最大化问题。对于一个在$n$个元素上的秩为$k$的拟阵，我们给出了一种随机化预言机多项式算法，该算法每轮进行一次可行的值查询，并具有期望的$(1-1/e)$-遗憾界$\widetilde O(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})$。这是第一个在一般拟阵约束下用于对抗性强盗子模最大化的次线性遗憾算法。在技术上，我们将该问题视为学习泊松基游走的交换策略。这将该问题与上下文强盗联系起来，并给出了信息论上的次线性遗憾保证，但直接学习指数多个策略需要指数级的时间和空间。因此，我们引入了\emph{平衡分数交换}，它将策略混合压缩为单个分数基，同时保留泊松分析所需的交换信息。这导致了一个多项式时间算法。
tldr: 本文提出了首个在一般拟阵约束下对抗性强盗子模最大化的次线性遗憾算法，通过引入平衡分数交换压缩策略，实现了多项式时间复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first sublinear-regret algorithm for adversarial bandit submodular maximization under general matroid constraints, achieving polynomial time via balanced fractional exchanges that compress policy mixtures.
